methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: this paper examines the flexible OPC UA standard, particularly concerning its applicability to energy monitoring

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Paper examines the OPC UA communication/interoperability framework (IEC 62541) and builds a sensor-retrofit prototype for distributed energy monitoring. EnPIs and ISO 50001 are cited only incidentally, as the purpose for which data must be networked; no EnPI/EnB measurement model is presented or characterised (no normalisation variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach). Falls under the v2.3 ineligibility clause for a tool/framework/software without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content.

paper_type.evidence_quote: As part of a prototypical case study, we carry out a retrofit on a classic energy meter and convert it into a CPS

stage1.notes: Repeated EnPI/ISO 50001 mentions are contextual (data to be networked to 'form EnPIs'), not a model. Rayyan 'Maybe'; eligibility is a judgment call worth human confirmation. No continuous-process sector named, so level_3b is not applicable under the ineligible-paper rule.
